sections.name: CrewPage
sections.title: Crew page layout and data
sections.what: Loads the crew, its open matches and, for the owner only, its reports. Draws the crew name, member count, invite panel, member list with action buttons, reports (owner only), upcoming matches with links and times, links to the tower and standings, and a leave button.
sections.why: Likely reason: one page gathers what a member needs, and management tools appear only for the owner.
sections.watch_out: Owner-only display here does not protect data; the server functions must check permissions.

summary: The main page for one private crew: shows its members, invite panel, owner-only reports, upcoming matches and links to standings.
purpose: Lets members see who is in the crew and open upcoming matches, and lets the owner manage members and reports.
why: Reason not stated in the code for putting everything on one page; owner-only sections suggest different permissions for owners and members.
how: Reads the crew id, finds the signed-in user, loads the crew only for a member, loads upcoming matches, and loads reports only for the owner. Draws the header, invite panel, member list with action buttons, reports, match list, links and a leave button.
inputs: Crew id from the address, the signed-in user, crew data from getCrewForMember, matches from openMatchesForCrew, and reports from listReports for the owner only.
outputs: A crew page with member count, invite panel, members with owner badges and admin buttons, owner-only reports, upcoming matches with times in UTC, and links to the timing tower and crew standings.
risks: Hiding buttons here is only a display choice; the data functions must enforce who may act, and this file does not show that. Reports contain member names and notes, so they must stay owner-only. Dates show in UTC, not the reader's local time.
debug: If the members list is wrong, check getCrewForMember. If the owner sees no reports, check listReports and the isOwner value. If a match time looks off, remember the time is in UTC.
